subject: Orion Health MAP draft — owners, timeline, and signature readiness
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orion Health MAP draft — owners, timeline, and signature readiness

Hi Emily — great conversation earlier. As promised, attached is MAP v1.2 (spreadsheet) summarizing milestones we discussed, owners, dependencies, and a target close window. High level recap below and a ask for next steps.

Summary (post-demo follow-up):
- Objective: Pilot Redwood Dedicated for oncology analytics inference across 3 lab regions. Success = <1s p50 token latency for 95% of requests under pilot load + billing within agreed unit price band.
- Target go-live (pilot): Oct 15, 2026 — target close for contract signature: Sep 10, 2026.
- Key milestones (owners):
  1) Prod-ready model onboarding & quant profile (Redwood / Priyom) — due Aug 20
  2) VPC peering & network validation (Orion / Daniel) — due Aug 27
  3) Security questionnaire & SOC evidence (Orion + Redwood security) — due Aug 10
  4) Integration spike & sample traffic (Orion devs) — due Sep 3
  5) Exec signature & SOW finalization (Orion legal + Redwood sales) — target Sep 10
- Dependencies: KMS key provisioning, firewall rules for peered subnets, and data retention classification from Orion security.

Asks:
1) Please review MAP v1.2 and confirm owners + dates or propose edits by EOD Tue Aug 3.
2) If the Sep 10 signature target is aggressive on your side, suggest an alternative date and we'll adjust the rollout plan accordingly.
3) Can Orion provide the SOC-2 contact (or security point) so Redwood security can exchange evidence?

Attachments: Orion-MAP-v1.2.xlsx, Redwood-SOW-draft.pdf

Thanks — appreciate the quick turn here. I’ll consolidate any edits into v1.3 and route to legal for SOW prep once we have owner agreement.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0126

From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@orionhealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@orionhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2026 13:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orion Health MAP draft — owners, timeline, and signature readiness

Thanks Aditya — good recap. A couple of small adjustments from our side after syncing with the engineering and security leads: 

- VPC peering & network validation (Orion / Daniel): can we move the due date to Sep 3 instead of Aug 27? Engineering wants two additional weeks for a vendor firewall review.
- Security questionnaire: I'll assign to our Security lead (Sandra Park) — she'll expect to exchange evidence via a secure share. Please have your SOC-2 summary and retention policy ready by Aug 6.
- Integration spike: Orion devs will do an initial spike Aug 22–26; full sample traffic window Sep 1–3.

We can likely keep the Sep 10 signature target if legal turns quickly, but we need Redwood to confirm the SOW will include the 60-day rollback clause we talked about on the call. Also need clarity on data residency options (can Redwood pin the Dedicated deployment to the us-west-2 region?).

I'll review v1.2 in detail and send annotated changes by COB Mon Aug 2.

Emily Zhang
Director of Platform Partnerships | Orion Health
emily.zhang@orionhealth.com

Quick internal — legal has provisionally agreed to include a 60-day rollback clause (standard language) and finance approved a 10% one-time onboarding credit for the pilot. Priyom, please incorporate the credit into the SOW draft and move pricing appendix to v1 of the SOW.

Ben — can you prepare a short summary of the onboard credit and impact to committed monthly units to include in the exec one-pager? I can get pricing approval updated in the internal tracker once that doc is attached.

—Marissa
VP, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@orionhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Updated MAP v1.3 (owners & dates) + final sign-off ask

Emily / team — thanks for the notes. Attached is Orion-MAP-v1.3.xlsx with the changes below applied:

- VPC peering due moved to Sep 3 (per Daniel)
- Security evidence due Aug 6 (SOC-2 summary attached in package)
- Integration spike moved to Aug 22–26 with sample traffic Sep 1–3
- SOW will include 60-day rollback clause (legal confirmed); SOW draft attached
- Onboarding credit (10%) added to pricing appendix (Ben)

Quick mutual action plan snapshot (plain text):
1) Security evidence exchange — Owner: Orion (Sandra Park) — Due: 2026-08-06
2) Prod model quant/profile onboarding — Owner: Redwood (Priyom) — Due: 2026-08-20
3) Integration spike — Owner: Orion Eng — Due: 2026-08-26
4) VPC peering & network validation — Owner: Orion (Daniel) — Due: 2026-09-03
5) Final SOW & exec sign-off — Owner: Orion Legal + Redwood Sales — Target: 2026-09-10

Ask: Please confirm by reply if owners & dates are acceptable. If we get explicit OK from Orion exec/legal by Tue Sep 7, Redwood will queue DocuSign and target a 48–72 hour turnaround for signatures so we can hit the Sep 10 window.

Attachments: Orion-MAP-v1.3.xlsx, Redwood-SOW-draft.pdf (updated)

—Aditya

From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@orionhealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@orionhealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated MAP v1.3 (owners & dates) + final sign-off ask

Confirmed — we are good to proceed with MAP v1.3 as attached.

- Exec/legal has penciled in Sep 8 for final review; Daniel will push for signatures on Sep 9.
- Data residency: Redwood confirmed ability to pin Dedicated to us-west-2 for the pilot — thanks for confirming offline.
- Sandra (security) will coordinate the SOC-2 exchange; I copied Priyom so he can expect the inbound secure share.

Please go ahead and queue DocuSign when you get the final exec approval. I’ll send the signed acceptance back and post the DocuSign link here.

Emily
